home.heroSubUnmeasured: Nothing has been measured yet. A scan reads sizes and deletes nothing.
home.safeRunTitle: A safe run, step by step
home.developerOn: On – keeping anything used in the last {{days}} days
home.developerOff: Off – every cache is offered in full
home.developerNote: Caches you have used recently are left alone, so your next build is not a cold one.
home.developerNoteOff: Nothing is being held back – every cache is offered in full.
home.heldBackCount_one: {{count}} cache used in the last {{days}} days
home.heldBackCount_other: {{count}} caches used in the last {{days}} days
home.idleWindowHint: Lower it to include more caches.
home.assure: Your documents, photos, keys and saved passwords are never touched — whatever you click here.
home.privacySummary: What leaves this machine, and what never does.
home.privacyIntro: The cleanup engine makes no network calls at all — its own tests check that. The window sends usage and crash reports, which is how windowsweep gets better for everyone:
home.privacySignIn: Signing in is optional. It syncs your settings and a summary of each run, and nothing else.
home.mapHint: Bigger tile, more space. Click one to keep it.
home.mapTableSummary: The same data as a table, with a switch for each target
home.mapAria: Reclaim map: $t(home.countTargets, {"count": {{targets}} }) across $t(home.countSections, {"count": {{sections}} }), {{amount}} reclaimable in total. The equivalent data is in the table below.
home.mapAriaExcluded: Reclaim map: $t(home.countTargets, {"count": {{targets}} }) across $t(home.countSections, {"count": {{sections}} }), {{amount}} reclaimable in total, with a further {{excludedAmount}} drawn dimmed and kept out of the run. The equivalent data is in the table below.
home.mapIdleRamp: faded = used recently, solid = long idle
home.mapExcludedCount_one: {{count}} target kept out of the run
home.mapExcludedCount_other: {{count}} targets kept out of the run
home.mapZeroBody: Every location behind these tiles is protected or in use. There is nothing here the scan is willing to touch.
home.mapUnmeasuredBody: A scan reads the size of every declared target and deletes nothing. The map draws what it finds.
home.ringAria: Capacity: {{reclaimable}} reclaimable, {{percent}} per cent of {{total}} across {{count}} drives. The same figures are in the Drives panel below.
home.ladderTotal: Total a safe run would free
home.ladderEmpty: Nothing in the safe batch right now.
home.needsHint: A safe run never touches these — you pick, item by item.
home.chokeBody: Every deletion in the product goes through one function, and that function is given a folder it is allowed to work inside. There is no second route, so a path outside that folder cannot be reached even by mistake.
home.chokeRefusedWhat: Protected, or outside the allowed folder
home.chokeRecycleWhat: Anything personal, so you can get it back
home.chokeDeletedWhat: Caches that rebuild themselves next time you need them
home.protectedCategoriesLead: And these kinds of thing, wherever they are:
home.protectedUnread: The engine has not published its protected list to this window yet. Run windowsweep --list-targets to read it.
home.sparkAria_one: Space freed by the last {{count}} run, oldest first: {{amounts}}
home.sparkAria_other: Space freed by the last {{count}} runs, oldest first: {{amounts}}
home.lastRunsEmpty: No run has finished in this window yet.
home.lastRunsEmptyNote: A dry-run costs nothing and deletes nothing, and it is recorded here like any other run.
home.scheduleNote: Runs the safe batch once a week and tells you what it freed. Never the sections that need you.
home.adminSummary_one: {{count}} section needs Windows to ask your permission first.
home.adminSummary_other: {{count}} sections need Windows to ask your permission first.
home.adminBody: Starting one opens a second window with its own log, because this window cannot answer a Windows permission prompt for you. It then follows that run and shows you the result.
home.adminSigning: The installer is not signed with a paid code-signing certificate, so Windows warns you the first time you open it. Saying so here costs less than letting you find out; the Administrator rights screen explains the dialog and what you can check instead.
run.titleFailed: The run stopped before it finished.
run.failedNote: Whatever it had already reclaimed is in the log below, and the last line says why it stopped.
run.dryRunNote: This was a dry-run. Run the same thing without it to reclaim the space.
run.logHint: never animates – this is the surface you watch while something irreversible happens
run.drainHint: Tiles leave as each section finishes
run.provenanceBody: The progress you see is reported by the cleanup engine itself as it works. This window displays it and does none of the deleting.
run.excludedHint_one: the engine refused {{count}} path you excluded
run.excludedHint_other: the engine refused {{count}} paths you excluded
run.cancelledNote: Run cancelled. {{amount}} had already been freed.
run.nothingToRun: Nothing in the safe batch to run.
